notes: Six own pages read (home, pricing, about, integrations and two own blog pages cited by the answers), all HTTP 200 and not thin. The pricing snapshot shows each plan as monthly then annual price under 'MONTHLY ANNUALLY (Save $120/user/year)': Solo $59/$49, Essential $79/$69, Business $99/$89, Business Pro $124/$114; its FAQ names exactly four plans. Cause checks: six cited pages requested, of which owlesq.com, rev.com and intellibill.io read (HTTP 200), capterra.com 403, kinja.com 429 and caeluslaw.net a network failure. Pass 2 (8 Oct): kinja.com was read once in a real browser and removed from needs_browser_read; it does not carry C19 (client portal tiers), so C19 stays cause not found; capterra.com and caeluslaw.net remain unread and listed for cause tracing only (no own-page claim depends on them). No PracticePanther own page was blocked, so step 1 re-classed nothing. Reviewer, look first at C14: the kinja.com page (third party, not cited by the q6 Perplexity 2 answer that makes the claim) says 'PracticePanther runs a permanent free tier capped at three active clients and three active matters' per Capterra, while the vendor's pricing page and FAQ list only four paid plans and a 7-day trial; C14 stays wrong under the own-page rule. Pass 2 consistency check: all seven wrong claims (C07 to C10, C12, C14, C19) are explicit, like-with-like contradictions on the vendor's pricing or integrations page and stay wrong; C10's proof quote was changed to the FAQ plan list because the $89 price exists under the Business name and only the plan name Advanced is contradicted. Pass 2 completeness: the gap lines and the comparison-table cells for PracticePanther ($39 and $49 starting prices, the $5,500 to $7,500 five-user estimate, $49 to $59) repeat claims already coded for the same answers; positioning, feature and support lines ('eSignature built in', '24/7 customer support', document assembly) were not coded. quickbase.com (cited by q2 Claude 2) was already read under the cosmolex budget and is the cause of C07. C08 to C10 and C12 (Basic $39, Pro $69, Advanced $89, 10-day trial) match word for word the MyCase entry of the cited owlesq.com guide, so the q1 Claude answers appear to have attached MyCase pricing to PracticePanther. C28 and C29 (40,000+ professionals, 170+ countries) and C31 (former attorney founder) appear verbatim on the cited quickbase.com page but not on the vendor's pages (which say tens of thousands), so they are unverifiable. q4 Claude 3's sentence was split three ways: client portal (C19, wrong), CRM (C20, unverifiable) and intake and e-signatures (instance of C16). Not coded: the q4 Perplexity 1 and 3 lines giving Solo at $49 to $59 'depending on tier and source' (attributed and conditional, so not statements), ratings, support quality, 'no hidden fees', 'longest free trial' (a comparison), user quotes from forums, and Rocket Matter's integration with PracticePanther (a statement about another vendor).
